Bislett Management Has Raised Its Stake in Discovery Communications (DISCK) as Market Value Declined; Cim Investment Mangement Upped Gilead Sciences (GILD) Position
May 20, 2018 - By Henry Gaston
Bislett Management Llc increased its stake in Discovery Communications Inc (DISCK) by 47.73% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Bislett Management Llc bought 105,000 shares as the company’s stock declined 12.19% with the market. The institutional investor held 325,000 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $6.88M, up from 220,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Bislett Management Llc who had been investing in Discovery Communications Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $16.29 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.83% or $0.4 during the last trading session, reaching $21.42. About 3.21M shares traded. Discovery, Inc. (NASDAQ:DISCK) has declined 27.22% since May 20, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 38.77% the S&P500.
Cim Investment Mangement Inc increased its stake in Gilead Sciences Inc (GILD) by 125.19% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Cim Investment Mangement Inc bought 8,131 shares as the company’s stock rose 1.93% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 14,626 shares of the health care company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.05M, up from 6,495 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Cim Investment Mangement Inc who had been investing in Gilead Sciences Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $88.44B market cap company. The stock increased 0.62% or $0.42 during the last trading session, reaching $68.02. About 5.42M shares traded. Gilead Sciences, Inc. (NASDAQ:GILD) has risen 9.79% since May 20, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 1.76% the S&P500.
Cim Investment Mangement Inc, which manages about $1.03 billion and $292.59M US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Union Pacific Corp (NYSE:UNP) by 6,291 shares to 7,765 shares, valued at $1.04 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Home Depot Inc (NYSE:HD) by 2,253 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 6,362 shares, and cut its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL).
